summary: Extending from a slice exceeding remaining capacity panicked. The fix introduces try_extend_from_slice, returning CapacityError without modifying the vector when insufficient capacity remains. The verbatim reversal restores only the overflow panic. Blocked: no existing upstream test at this commit exercises that branch. The updated test_extend_from_slice and doctest use slices that fit; test_write reaches the method only after truncating input to remaining capacity. No builds or tests were run.
